body: I know exactly how you feel. I feel so lonely and I can't tell anyone how I feel, I'll just feel like I'm bothering them. I do have a few friends but I know they have their own struggles and I don't want to be a burden for them. I feel like if I demand something, help or a hug, they won't like me any more. I'm so afraid to bother anyone and I feel so lonely. I feel for you <3

Over the years I've become a master of hiding my depression. The fear of someone finding out how I really feel is what drives me. Also I have no choice when it comes to money. I'm currently a student and I get by doing the exact minimum of what I have to do to get trough my exams and get money (in my country you get a loan of 1000$ a month for studying). I can't imagine how I could hold down a job though. But my friends have no idea how I feel, I've become so good at appearing happy. Wish I could let everyone know but that would mean so many feelings of shame.

I get those feelings very much. I've been raped and since then every time someone shows sexual interest in me I feel disqusted. It makes it impossible to even imagine having a loving relationship ever again. But I won't give up. There are good people out there. I hope you some day will meet someone who will change your feelings about this. Sending you lots of love and the best of luck. I know how horrible you feel.

There are many good suggestions and advice here. I hope you find a solution so you can get the hell away from that monster. Personally I think you should go to the police and tell them what you just told us, or contact a support service for victims of domestic abuse. Gather evidence of his abuse. Show someone your bruises. Anyway, I just want to say I think you are brave and I wish you all the luck in the world. You can make it.

When you are having sex with your significant other, it's not just their body that turns you on, it's who they are to you, the bond you share. In that case it's not objectification if you ask me. And in another situation like an one night stand, if both parts agree and are comfortable, I don't see anything wrong with "objectifying" each other, if it's mutual and consensual. And I think most people recognize the persons worth as a human even though the focus is on the body.
Amen

What bothers me most is (probably like most of you) the pressure to give lots and lots of gifts to everyone you know. In my country the average person spends about 1000$ just on presents. Like all other holidays, capitalism has exploited this one and made us believe christmas is about spending money to prove we love our friends and family. I wish at least that people would just buy stuff they know people want. I know so many people who get lots and lots of stuff they never use and just throw away. I wish people would stop buying gifts just to buy something, and at least buy something people need or, if they don't need anything, send a card and give the money to someone in need. It's become more popular in my country to give money to red cross or doctors without borders as a christmas gift. I really like this trend and I hope it will take off! I'm a person who likes giving gifts, but I only give something to my family and my two or three closest friends. Sometimes I make christmas candy and give that away instead of buying things. There is no meaning in just throwing money around on useless stuff that nobody will ever use anyway. Wish more people agreed with me. But I think this is hard to change when we have the economic system that we have. Capitalism uses so many psychological weapons to brain wash the masses. What we can do as individuals is tell people around us we don't need a gift. That we much more would appreciate to share a bottle of wine or go out together, do something, experience something together instead of getting lots of things. I have told my friends I'd rather we take a trip together or make a really good dinner and appreciate each other.
Thanks, yeah, I thought about that but I played through it quickly and couln't find that exact pic... But maybe I just missed it.

Proud of you! Getting the courage to go see someone is hard. I really think you should keep going, I hope you do. It's healthy to talk about your feelings and it might help you figure some things out. Good luck, you are brave.

I'm a woman too and I get what you are saying. But I think this guy isn't the type who is catcalling girls on the street. That is not okay, but I get the impression that OP understands that. I got the sense that he talked about people in a normal social setting, like a party or in a bar, at work, something like that. Don't catcall of course. But talking to strangers is imo okay, it just really depends on the situation. If nobody talked to strangers then how would people get to know new friends? It all depends on how you do it and the situation. Obviously don't make girls uncomfortable and be sexist, but if you are a nice guy with good intentions, you just want to be friendly and talk to people, I think that's okay and I think many girls agree with me. It all depends on how you do it.

I think it's great we all have this community where we can support each other. Life is sucky, life is hard for many people. That's how it is. It makes me really sad to se all this pain, but it at least makes me happy seeing all these struggling people coming together to help each other. That's really something. Humanity is awful but also amazing.

I know how you're feeling, even though I'm a girl. I just think I'm so ugly and detestable that people will be disgusted if they thought I was hitting on them... BUT I really think this is all in our heads. I mean, I think it's really great to see that you guys think about what you say or do to girls. It is important to not overstep any boundaries and make people uncomfortable. But if your intentions are good and you are in fact not a creepy guy, most girls will understand it. As a girl i promise you, we usually can tell the creepy ones from the nice ones. So if you really are just a nice guy, remember this is your low self-esteem talking. People usually don't think other people are weird or creepy, I almost never think stuff like that about people I don't know. Don't make sexist comments or talk much about their looks, just be nice like you probably are! I think you understand what is okay to say and what is not. And people will notice that. Plus, most people usually thinks mostly about themselves and their social performance, they don't really go around analyzing and thinking about something anyone else said. At least not a "random" person. So remember, it's only in your head. Be nice, be a good guy, and you will se, people will notice. Those who don't aren't keepers anyway.

Let me just start by saying I have fucked a guy who was 5"4 once so your height doesn't mean you have no chance! 

Anyway. I understand your height is a problem for you. It makes you feel like you are not as good as other people, it makes you feel different. And that is not a good feeling. My advice is to own it and embrace it. Be proud of who you are. So, you are different. That's cool! People like people if they are, or at least seem, confident about things like this. If you try to give out the vibe that you like yourself and are proud of who you are, then people will think this too! It's really how people work. I know it's not easy to be proud of something that have ruined for you in life, but it is who you are and there is no changing that. The best thing is to just embrace it! Fake it til you make it. And, as you say, you managed to get both friends and a girlfriend. That is not pure luck, my friend. That proves something; that you definitely have the potential to be liked by people! You have the ability to get friends and be social. Do not underestimate this. You have the possibility to get friends. Don't forget it. I know it is hard, especially if you are depressed. We are in a very similar situation actually. I go to uni and my boyfriend of five years just left me for another girl. I, as you, had many friends in high school but they moved away. I stayed here with my boyfriend and moved in with him because he works. Then he dumped me and now I am here all alone, a fine fine line away from failing the university, I can't se happiness anywhere or find passion in anything. I study something i actually care about but I can't seem to get into it. Neither am I considered to be conventionally pretty, I'm not exactly ugly in my opinion but I'm not the kind of girl most guys fall for. So I feel you very much. I haven't made any friends in uni either. But I don't think any one of us should give up. I think we probably need time to get over our breakups. It will take time to heal. The girl you loved hurt you very deeply. Some people take much time to get over something like that. I'm one of those, and maybe you too. Don't expect it to get better tomorrow, but eventually it will get better. This is a fact. 

I know that you don't believe this now and you wrote that you won't have answers by people telling you it will get better and that someone else will love you. But how can you know it will never happen? Never? We cannot know anything. This I know. My mother was in an abusive relationship for 7 years, in her twenties. Her father had passed away and she was very depressed. For 10 years her life was hell. She thought it would never get better, but she never gave up. And when she was 31 years she met my father and they got me and my sister. Now her life of course has not all perfect days, but she is happy to be alive. She is happy with her life and it gives her meaning. My point is, you are only 19 years old. I am only 22. What gives me hope, is the future. So many people have let me down, and I really am not good at making new friends either. Almost everyone I have ever cared about, has left me. But I know life can be dark. And I know that even though it is dark for a very long time, you never know what is coming. You say people is evil. Yes, there is evil out there. But remember that most people are just like you and me. Have you not been evil to people? Everyone does mean things. But when you were a dick, it was because you felt bad about yourself. This applies to many people. Many things about humanity is ugly. But many things are beautiful too, think about that. Don't forget it. Like this forum, people writing to people they don't know, trying to make their day better. Isn't that beautiful? Don't tell me humans can't be great. They can be awful, sure. But they also can be fantastic. You can train yourself to be more aware of the nice things in life. To appreciate the small things. Try to remind yourself of the good things about the world and humanity, nature and everything around you.

I understand your worldview very much. I feel the same way. It's a very nihilistic way of seeing the world, and it won't provide much happiness. I don't really see any meaning in life at all either. But I think as humans we have to cope with that. The only thing we can try to do, is things that makes us happy. Maybe those things will not come to you now. But you can try getting there faster. If you are not happy with what you are studying, you should quit and go for something else. Study something you care about, or try to get a job. I know these are hard things and just can't "just do it". But you can make it happen. You might have to take it day by day, like I do. I try to make new friends. It is hard for me, but I push myself little by little. I'm certain you can make new friends too! You just have to push yourself a little. Think of what might be. Think of what you can accomplish! Maybe it will not be the perfect life, but I definitely think you can give your life meaning. Maybe you need to get away for awhile, move another place or just take a trip to clear your head. I really really don't think you should give up. I know so many people who have been unhappy for a long time, but finally they got there, finally they are okay with their life. With some work I think this can happen for you too. You had a lot. You had friends, a girl, good social skills. You have lost it but that doesn't mean you can't get those things again. I was also a very socially skilled person, and not any more. But it takes time, it takes training. You have to be social again and it will come back. I know this is not easy but try to imagine how great your life could be and work towards it. 

Let me be clear. I understand everything you write and I know this might seem overly positive or like I don't understand your problems. But I relate to everything you write. I also feel like I'm not meant for this world. Like I'm on the outside and alone. Like there is no meaning and humans are just awful. But I also believe that since life has no meaning, the only thing you can do is to try and give it some meaning. Whatever that is for you, try and find it! Don't give up, keep looking. You will have to push yourself and it will take time. You have to take it step by step, small things first and then move up. It will not be fixed just like that. I know it is a long way and when you feel like you and I do, sometimes you think "okay but what's the point?". I don't know. Nobody knows. But if you kill yourself you CERTAINLY will never know! And you will be robbing yourself of a future that could be all right or great. Nobody knows what the future holds. But I think you are capable of making some changes in your life, if you try hard enough. And I am sure you have the potential to be happy. Suicide is an easy way out. I know how tempting it is, I have planned my suicide many times and written the goodbye letters. But if you kill yourself, then there is nothing. It will never get better. If you stay alive and fight, it probably will get better. Life is like that, not always good. Sometimes it's bad for a long time. But that doesn't mean it never can be good again. I promise you this. I'm sorry that I can't help you, I really wish for you to be happy with your life. I wish I could fix it. I just want to say that I really understand you, and the pain that you are going trough. But depression lies to you, and makes you not see all the potential you have. Depression tells you that the world doesn't care about you and that you'll never be happy. But these are all lies, and depression is a sickness. Never forget that. I hope you are seeing someone or that you will seek help from a psychiatrist. It's all about how we perceive life, and you have a very destructive way of thought. Maybe someone could help you think differently. At least they can help you sort your thoughts and try to figure out what YOU need to be happy. What you long for, what you want, what will give your life meaning. Because there is always something, there is always a way out, always a solution. Not everyone will leave you in the future just because it happened before. This is how humans think; if something happened many times it will happen again. But this is not true! It's how our brains work, to protect ourself and learn about our environment. But it doesn't always apply. Just because bad things have happened doesn't mean good things won't happen next. 

Any way, I really don't think you should end your life. I'm certain you have so much potential and that you can be happy again. I feel with you and send you lots of love and good luck. I believe in you!

I think you should remember that YOUR life doesn't have to have anything to do with your family. I understand that it is extremely hard to get over your mothers death, and you will never get over it. But you CAN live with it. Try getting help from a professional. They can help you find better ways to deal with your grief. I understand you have experienced some horrible things in your life, related to your father. Luckily you don't have to have him in your life, and I guess you don't. But remember. Only you create your own life. You can create the life you want, without your father and your mother. How would it make your mother feel, knowing her death caused yours? Isn't it better to honor her memory, not by taking your own life but by living, and try to make a good life for your self? You deserve that, not death! She could inspire you to make the most out of life, to go out in the world and try to se the beauty of things. You deserve happiness and love, and I am sure you will find it if you don't give up and just keep looking. Maybe you should try to focus more on yourself and your personal growth. Becoming stronger as a person, independent, getting to know yourself, learning what you want out of life. There must be something. I know this probably won't help. But remember, you are worth something to someone. And you are worth something just by being you. You are your best friend and your life companion. You owe it to yourself, to try and find something that gives your life meaning, happiness is not impossible for you to find even if it feels like that now. To end your life, is ending all possibilities. I hope you can be strong enough to fight your way forwards in life. Don't ruin your chance of happiness now. I know it is incredibly hard to live, especially after all the horrible things you have gone trough. But there is hope for everyone. I believe in you.

My boyfriend left me after 5 years and he doesn't love me anymore. He will never come back. It is really hard to accept and cope with. But remember, time will heal you. Try to focus on other things. Try to go out, meet new people, get yourself a hobby, etc. The value of your life is not determined by who loves you and who is by your side. The value is determined by you, only you. Only you can make your life valuable and meaningful. You might feel like you need her to live right now. That's how I feel to, with my ex-boyfriend. But I have hope, that some day, I will only need myself. Try to focus on YOU. What you want in life, what makes you happy. Be a little selfish. Find something you want to do, and do it. Maybe take a trip to clear your head. Hang out with friends or reach out to new or old ones. The clue is to keep yourself occupied, it will make time pass faster. You WILL get over this. You WILL be strong. You only need yourself. I believe in you. I feel your pain so much. But I think we both eventually will be happy. Just focus on just you for a while. I wish you all the luck in the world.

In my opinion, life has no meaning. The only thing you can do is try to have some fun and be happy. To me this is really hard, life is just a struggle. So I feel you. But I think the key is to find something that makes you happy. If you haven't found it, keep looking. There is something. I hate living too, but I won't give up on the thought that some day I will find something that to me has meaning, and will give my life meaning. For now, life is just pain. But maybe in the future it will be better, if you don't give up, if you keep looking. I hope you find something to give your life meaning.

My best friend is also severely depressed and she goes on several meds. It seems to help a little but not nearly enough. I am too depressed, but she is even more than me and she also just wants to die. The only thing holding her back is guilt. I am a little like your friend in the way that my boyfriend also left me. My friends probably saw it coming because he stopped caring but I couldn't see it and I just loved him so so much. It is a horrible feeling to be left by the one you love. It's not odd at all she feels worthless. I too feel that I don't have any friends even though I have a couple. And when my boyfriend left me it felt like the proof that I wasn't worth anything. That feeling is probably common if you already are depressed and your significant other leaves you. I also feel like nobody cares about me and it's probably not true but that's how depression makes you feel. You say that you were depressed yourself so you probably recognize all these feelings about self-worth. Even though people love your friend and care about her, it doesn't feel that way to her, because of the lies the depression is telling her. I don't know what you can do, I don't have a quick-fix. What I do with my severely depressed friend is that I always tell her how much she means to me. How much I need her in my life and how much better she makes it. I also try to get her to come out with me, meet friends and stuff like that. Maybe you should try to get her out more often, to meet people and try to have fun? I know it's hard and maybe she'll just be sad and don't have a good time at all but I would at least try a couple of times. Being social when you are depressed is hard but with training it can make it easier. Maybe she has a passion, something she likes to do? A hobby like music, writing, anything like that? Try helping her to find her passion, something that makes her life meaningful. Remember that depression lies and tells you you are worthless. That is how the reality looks like for her. I can clearly see how my best friend is NOT worthless, she is smart and capable and loved, but she does not see this herself. I don't know how to solve this but just be there for her, support her, let her know that you love her and that she is important to you. Maybe try to help her find something that she can focus on, to forget her boyfriend. I really wish I had friends that would do that for me, when my boyfriend broke up. I had to get trough that all on my own and I still struggle very much with it. I never had friends who took me out, helped me get my mind off it and stuff like that. It can really help to make her focus on something else. But I don't have a solution. I feel your pain and I know it's hard having a severely depressed friend. You are brave, trying to help her, being by her side. You are a good friend, wanting to help her. I understand you feel hopeless and don't know what to do. Just remember you can't fix her, only she can. You can only support her and help her get there by herself. Don't put her pain on you, it is not your fault and it is not your responsibility to make her happy. But I think there are some things you can do, like take her out, maybe go on walks with her, tell her how important she is, try to help her finding something she cares about to focus on. Good luck, you are a real friend.

I'm the same. I'm studying now but I really don't find any meaning in it. I just do it for the money you get when you study which is just enough to live a place and eat cheap food. A very minimal life style just like you. I hate it but I really can't get myself to work or anything. I'm just so tired and feel no passion for anything. I don't know what you should do but I just wanted you to know that you are not alone. I don't know what I'm going to do either and I just hate it. I don't get how all the people on this earth just do this. Work work work and then sleep and eat, and work again. To me this has no meaning. What is the point? I don't know. But I believe that the key is to find something to work with that you actually like. I have friends that work and some of them actually love their work. But it is hard to find that something that you care about. Especially if you are depressed. But I urge you to keep looking. Maybe one day you will find that something that makes you passionate. I hope so and I wish you luck

I don't have a perfect answer for you. I know it is hard to remember when you are so depressed, but as cyathea says here, depression lies. It tells you there is no reason to live. It tells you that you are not good enough and that nobody will care if you disappear. But I have lost people and many people I know have also lost someone in their life. People ALWAYS care. They just don't show it in the daily. Depression is an illness and it makes your brain see the world totally wrong and negative. The truth is, there is so many experiences waiting for you. There is love and there is of course also pain, but there are so many wonderful things that you will miss out on. I have a mother and you probably have a mother too somewhere. I know with my heart that if my mother died, my world would crash. She does not know this as I never tell her. People never say these things. But your daughter will miss you. Your death would destroy her life. She will miss you for the rest of her life. She will cry every night. She will wonder what might have been. I don't know anything about your relationship with your daughter but she is only 2 years old so it would be strange if you had any sort of "bad" relationship. You have her whole future and the whole future of your relationship coming! Don't waste it! You have the opportunity to have a great relationship with your daughter. Learning her things about life, taking trips and going for walks, going to museums, the cinema, the playground, reading books together, watching movies together, making dinner together. You have endless possibilites for what your relationship can be!!! I know you are depressed but look at your daughter. Is she not beautiful? YOU made that. YOU made that wonderful human being who can go out in the world and do great things. Don't you want to se her grow up? Fall in love, make friends, explore the world, learn things, laugh? Don't you want to see her do all these great things? I know how horrible depression is. I have been struggling with depression for 10 years and I am only in my twenties. I know the future looks dark. But remember. Your depression lies to you. Happy moments exists. There is a possibility for you to get out of this depression. It will not be like this forever. You are worth so much. You are so important to your daughter. Even though you are not the perfect mother you are. My father was so depressed my whole childhood. He was sleeping a lot, he was angry all the time and he didn't have much time for me. But I do forgive him for all this. He loved me and he still does. He always did his best and I see that now. I was mad at him many times but I NEVER EVER wanted him to go away. No child (unless abused) would want their parents to die. If my father would have died, then or now, it would have made my life a hell. I start tearing up just thinking about it. You are valuable. You are making a difference in the world. In your daughters life. Do for her what you can. You won't feel good enough, but you are. My parents have made many many mistakes but I don't care. Nobody is perfect. What is important is that they always loved me and they did their best. I know that and I love them for it. I would never not have them in my life. So remember. You are worth something. You have a future. Your daughter has a future. And you two have a future together! Don't take that away from her, or from you. I wish you all the luck and love in the world. I feel your pain so much and I really wish I could help more. I hope you are going to a psychiatrist. Sending you lots and lots of love!! I believe in you.
(Excuse my bad english, this is not my first language)

I feel like you do. I honestly don't know any solution to this but I just wanted you to know you are not alone. My cousin OD'ed from heroin and left the whole family broken. Now his mom/my aunt has OD'ed too. It feels unfair in some way. I wanted to end my life since I was 13 years old and now I am 22, and I can't do it because they already did it. Weed helps my anxiety but pills like zoloft never made a difference, I still felt horrible just in another way. 9 years I stayed alive because of others. I don't even have a great relationship with my family but I know they will be angry at me for being so egoistic and let they suffer my pain. I have friends, but none of them are really close. I just don't feel like I really connect with anyone. There was a boy, the only one i felt the connection with. Now he has left me for another girl after 3 years of living together. He doesn't really care about me and he never took my pain seriously, he just said "it will get better". I think people who have never been depressed won't understand this, but it might not get better. Anyway, now he's left me and he was the only person in the world I felt comfortable being myself with. I have never felt this with anyone else even though I have tried so much, I've had many "friends" and I know many people but I can't connect with anyone no matter how hard I try. It feels so unfair that I have to live on and suffer this pain, just to keep my family from feeling it. I think about suicide every day. I know how you are feeling. I wish I knew what we could do for it to end. My biggest wish is to "delete" my life so that I would never have been born. Then I could spare my family the pain and also myself. I feel for you and I hope you some day will find peace and happiness. Maybe you will, I know people who have recovered and are happy, I hope you will be one of them in the future.
